description: This file is a shell script that defines functions and tests for pushing to a git repository with push options, including setup for repositories, hooks, and tests for push option behaviors.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories (upstream and workbench), configuring hooks for push options and setting up reverse repositories.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares specific refs between upstream and workbench repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a series of commands related to push options.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the command to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a string within command output.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an httpd server for testing repository access.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server for pushing and fetching repositories, with optional push options support.
